profile_text.body:
Truyo is a software company whose platform is designed to help organizations manage AI governance, privacy compliance, consent and preference management, and third-party risk assessment. The company describes its offering as an all-in-one solution that enables businesses to identify and track AI usage across departments, scan websites, source code, and content for AI footprints, and maintain a centralized repository of identified AI risks and their associated use cases. The platform also includes tools for testing AI models against bias, discrimination, and hallucination concerns, employee training through a built-in or exportable learning management system, and pre-built connectors the company calls Truyo QuikLinks for integrating with existing technology stacks to support data mapping and data subject access request automation.

The core product, also called Truyo, sits in the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category and grew out of consent and privacy automation work. It provides automated AI inventory, risk assessment, and compliance workflows, and has been recognized in Gartner's 2026 AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant. The company's site also notes that Truyo was named a 2023 Innovation Award Finalist by IAPP and has been recognized by Forrester for its capabilities in serving large enterprises.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
